newsitem.title: PERU: Nestle buys 98.7 pct of Peru's D'Onofrio -official.
newsitem.headline: Nestle buys 98.7 pct of Peru's D'Onofrio -official.

text.p: Switzerland's Nestle SA has bought 98.7 percent of Peru's largest ice-cream and confectionery company D'Onofrio, the Lima Stocks and Securities Board (CONASEV) said Tuesday.
Nestle informed CONASEV of the purchase late Monday and will announce the price at a later date, CONASEV official Jorge Orbegoso said in an interview.
"The transfer is already in the public register. D'Onofrio is now Nestle," Orbegoso said.
Investors on the Lima stock exchange reacted positively Tuesday to the conclusion of a deal that the two companies have been negotiating for about a year.
D'Onofrio, a Lima blue chip stock, rose 6.38 percent to 1.50 soles in the first hour of Tuesday's session on the exchange.
